# ShortcutKey

Displays a keyboard shortcut.

```html
<noora-shortcut-key>⌘K</noora-shortcut-key>
```

| Attribute | Type or allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `small`, `large` | `"large"` | Controls the key dimensions. |
